evidence_boundaries: No model, optimizer, forward, backward, dataset, image, VAL or TEST was constructed/read/executed.
All tensor loads used weights_only=True and map_location=cpu. Native-module export pickle files were not opened.
Finite state/moments and update consistency do not establish correct predictions or a causal source of zero AP.
The 104-to-105 moment difference approximates the optimizer-fed post-unscale/post-clip gradient, with FP32 cancellation error; it is not the raw preclip gradient or historical gradient sequence.
The FP32 roundoff bound is a conservative arithmetic estimate, not a formal implementation-specific error proof; foreach/fused arithmetic may differ from the single-tensor emulation.
BN statistics are persisted buffers/affine tensors; no feature activation distributions or runtime BN epsilon were measured.
Periodic checkpoint spacing cannot localize events within each 105-update interval. Both final slots are update2100 and cannot reveal update2099-to-2100 gradients.
AdamW adaptive/decay proxies at periodic snapshots are algebraic summaries, not additional optimizer updates or matched J1/J2 interventions.
No missing YOLO box/seg/cls/dfl loss or foreground history can be reconstructed from these saved tensors.
J1/J2 tensor differences are observational across two training procedures; no abnormal statistic alone attributes collapse to Pair Ranking.
state_deltas.csv covers all floating state including BN buffers. Parameter-only adjacent deltas were not separately retained; they cannot be derived by subtracting aggregate L2 norms.
Parameter-only moments/weight trajectories and BN comparisons are descriptive; no new forward/backward was used to test feature distributions or intervention effects.
observations: All 25 loaded plain-tensor checkpoints were finite and CPU-only, with their persisted MASTER/EMA hashes verified and all registered inputs unchanged.

J1 and J2 Last have identical model configuration/class metadata, state keys/shapes, optimizer-name ordering and final optimizer hyperparameters. This does not establish a matched training intervention.
The large all-floating-state norms are dominated by BN running_var buffers. Separate parameter-only statistics are supplied so these are not described as weight explosion.

Several J2 final BN variance tensors are much larger than the J1 Last observational reference. This justifies a BN-state/activation hypothesis, but does not prove BN caused zero AP or that Pair caused the drift.
J1 also has large head/proto running variances; a large BN statistic by itself is not sufficient to declare failure.
The B0 104-to-105 AdamW tensor formula agrees closely with the observed actual update; this checks one step only and cannot be generalized to the full 2100-update gradient history.
B1 final slots both hold update2100, and all physical training fields are identical. Only extra differs, consistent with AUX changing metadata rather than training tensors.
The DFL constant is unchanged in all aggregate deltas and has no AdamW state, as expected for its frozen parameter.
No NaN/Inf, negative persisted BN variance, negative AdamW second moment or missing trainable moment state was observed in the inspected checkpoints.
Final head classification biases overlap the J1 range; biases alone cannot recover logits, assignment, detection confidence or explain AP.
parameter_only_definition: All state entries except running_mean/running_var/num_batches_tracked; 295 tensors equal the exact optimizer-name count, including frozen DFL.
